findings.title: Home misreports every connected signed physical reader as an unavailable handshake
findings.observed: Physical signed-protocol hello succeeds and the controller publishes connected_reader with reason=null and prototype_sensor association. presentDevice has no connected_reader branch, so returns connected=false, Reader connection unavailable and an unverified-handshake/reconnect explanation. Installing a service binding does not alter this missing branch. Home displays Not ready for capture and unconditional all-channel-unavailable text, while DevicePanel distinguishes connected signed protocol and service-verified binding.
findings.reproduction: Read-only deterministic path inspection, no new runtime/test execution: pass a genuine controller connected_reader snapshot (current association, reason:null, either null or installed verifiedBindingId) to presentDevice; all connected_simulator/scanning/connecting/idle predicates fail and final fallback is selected. HomeDeviceSummary always renders that returned fallback. Existing device-presentation.test.ts never passes connected_reader.
findings.impact: Home contradicts the actual connection and Device screen, directs a successfully connected user to reconnect, and conceals installed conditional acquisition behind fixed unavailable copy. Connection, verified binding and independently admitted capture must remain distinct states.
findings.required_correction: Handle the actual signed-reader state in presentation, distinguishing connection/identity unverified versus service-bound reader without upgrading it to measurement qualification. Derive channel availability from current admitted scope or use truthful qualification-required wording; remove the unconditional all-channel unavailable assertion when incompatible with current capabilities. Preserve stale/disconnect/boot/source guards.
findings.verification_criterion: Assertions on actual HomeDeviceSummary/presentDevice with unbound signed reader, matching service-bound reader, current qualified-channel versus denied/expired capability, disconnect and boot replacement. Connected signed reader must not say handshake failed or Synthetic only; binding alone never enables capture or model authority. Confirm Device/Home agreement with explicit fixture provenance.

initial_finding_closure.reason: CheckRow and Home use verified state/scope helpers; actual row/history/result tests distinguish measurement_only/invalid/inconclusive/admitted research/abstention, reject changed proof/legacy/synthetic claims and leave delivery independent. HR numeric read now additionally requires current admission. No obsolete source defect carried forward; final combined-source execution pending.

Actual heading .toBeFocused assertions cover Home/Settings/Privacy/History/deeper Back; named dialog heading receives focus and Cancel restores trigger. Helper cancels detached/stale/deferred work and respects newer web user focus. Native API invocation is implemented; actual TalkBack/VoiceOver/browser-cancel/large-text OS execution absent.

Exact current seven-gate execution running. The readable local-gates.json is revision28 historical and is not accepted for this candidate. Per-case current reconciliation and current CI not yet supplied.

Compilation/core/browser fixtures do not execute actual OS camera/BLE permission dialogs/Settings return, SQLCipher unlock/key loss/process death, share-sheet cleanup or assistive-technology behavior. No target runtime evidence was supplied.
